title: Privacy Preserving Gossip Learning
summary: We propose a decentralized privacy-preserving learning algorithm in which each agent holds a single private sample and a shared model. Samples are learned sequentially, and each update must preserve the endpoint mappings at previously learned samples while protecting private data. This gives each agent three roles: (i) a learner that updates the model parameters, (ii) a teacher whose sample is learned at the current iteration, and (iii) a protected agent whose sample has already been learned.
